cond_0001.intro:
The Investment Manager Services Division (IMS) at [Company name masked] is growing rapidly and is seeking new members on our Collective Investment Trusts (CIT) team. As an operations analyst, you will coordinate the day-to-day administrative and regulatory functions for our growing list of collective trusts/funds.
[Company name masked]'s CIT Team is responsible for establishing and maintaining collective trusts under the rules of its direct regulator and standards of the Department of Labor, Internal Revenue Service and other regulatory bodies. This team works closely with internal divisions including the ITA, IFS, Compliance, Legal, etc. The CIT Team currently supports around 470 collective funds with almost $100 + Billion in AUM working with over 135 investment sub-advisors.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
What you will do:
You will handle daily activities associated with collective funds; including but not limited to trade processing, administrative support, and operational setups
You will prepare account opening and maintenance documents for foreign market investments
You will assist CIT Specialists and Trust Officers with governmental filings and regulatory reporting; preparation of materials to be presented to Trust Company board and committees
You will assist in leading access to the CIT website and oversee all processes related to the maintenance of the website
As a record keeper for the funds, you will be working supportively with internal teams regarding the establishment/maintenance of new or changed funds or fund share classes. Additionally, you will be organizing vital reporting for sub-advisors and internal teams
You will communicate with appropriate internal teams or client teams to resolve open issues and questions, collaborate with internal technology support and vendor support when necessary to resolve any production issues or system support queries
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
BA / BS in Business, Accounting, Finance, Economics, Mathematics or equivalent experience
Intermediate skills in Microsoft Excel
Strong written and verbal communication skills as you will primarily support your clients through email and/or phone calls
Strong customer service skills as you will be communicating daily with internal and external clients
Positivity and congenial approach in assisting both colleagues and clients and the ability to work in team environment
Preferred Requirements:
Experience in any of the following fields: Collective Trust Funds, Employee Benefits, Investments, trust and/or insurance administration is ideal but not necessary
The self-motivation and aim to supervise multiple client deliverables without sacrificing excellence or quality
An aim to broaden one's knowledge of the financial services industry by learning new concepts and systems and taking the initiative to apply it to daily work assignments
Collaboration with internal and external partners. As the needs of our clients change, we need to be flexible to change with them
Curiosity, critical thinking and attention to detail: Whether it's to identify a solution to a problem or possibly help implement a more efficient process or procedure, your skills have a place in our business
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0001.values: We value responsibility, respect, and a genuine commitment to doing right by others. We aim to create outcomes that are fair, thoughtful, and beneficial to the people we serve.
cond_0001.inclusion: At [Company name masked], we're not all the same. And that's our greatest strength. We draw on the differences in who we are, what we've experienced and how we think. Because to create products that serve everyone, we believe in including everyone. Therefore, we are committed to treating all applicants fairly and equally.
cond_0001.workplace_support: We value work-life harmony and recognize that doing your best work should not come at the expense of life outside work. We aim to offer flexibility and support so employees can thrive both professionally and personally.

As an operations analyst, you will coordinate the day-to-day administrative and regulatory functions for our growing list of collective trusts/funds.
[Company name masked]'s CIT Team is responsible for establishing and maintaining collective trusts under the rules of its direct regulator and standards of the Department of Labor, Internal Revenue Service and other regulatory bodies. This team works closely with internal divisions including the ITA, IFS, Compliance, Legal, etc. The CIT Team currently supports around 470 collective funds with almost $100 + Billion in AUM working with over 135 investment sub-advisors. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the regulatory and operational logic that underpins collective fund administration.
cond_0031.responsibilities:
You will handle daily activities associated with collective funds; including but not limited to trade processing, administrative support, and operational setups
You will prepare account opening and maintenance documents for foreign market investments
You will assist CIT Specialists and Trust Officers with governmental filings and regulatory reporting; preparation of materials to be presented to Trust Company board and committees
You will assist in leading access to the CIT website and oversee all processes related to the maintenance of the website
As a record keeper for the funds, you will be working supportively with internal teams regarding the establishment/maintenance of new or changed funds or fund share classes. Additionally, you will be organizing vital reporting for sub-advisors and internal teams
You will communicate with appropriate internal teams or client teams to resolve open issues and questions, collaborate with internal technology support and vendor support when necessary to resolve any production issues or system support queries
cond_0031.requirements:
BA / BS in Business, Accounting, Finance, Economics, Mathematics or equivalent experience
Experience in any of the following fields: Collective Trust Funds, Employee Benefits, Investments, trust and/or insurance administration is ideal but not necessary
Intermediate skills in Microsoft Excel
The self-motivation and aim to supervise multiple client deliverables without sacrificing excellence or quality
Strong written and verbal communication skills as you will primarily support your clients through email and/or phone calls
Strong customer service skills as you will be communicating daily with internal and external clients
An aim to broaden one's knowledge of the financial services industry by learning new concepts and systems and taking the initiative to apply it to daily work assignments
Collaboration with internal and external partners. As the needs of our clients change, we need to be flexible to change with them
Positivity and congenial approach in assisting both colleagues and clients and the ability to work in team environment
Curiosity, critical thinking and attention to detail: Whether it's to identify a solution to a problem or possibly help implement a more efficient process or procedure, your skills have a place in our business
cond_0031.values: We value responsibility, respect, and a genuine commitment to doing right by others. We aim to create outcomes that are fair, thoughtful, and beneficial to the people we serve.
cond_0031.inclusion: At [Company name masked], we're not all the same. And that's our greatest strength. We draw on the differences in who we are, what we've experienced and how we think. Because to create products that serve everyone, we believe in including everyone. Therefore, we are committed to treating all applicants fairly and equally.
cond_0031.workplace_support: We value work-life harmony and recognize that doing your best work should not come at the expense of life outside work. We aim to offer flexibility and support so employees can thrive both professionally and personally.

cond_0316.intro:
The Investment Manager Services Division (IMS) at [Company name masked] is growing rapidly and is seeking new members on our Collective Investment Trusts (CIT) team. As an operations analyst, you will coordinate the day-to-day administrative and regulatory functions for our growing list of collective trusts/funds.
[Company name masked]'s CIT Team is responsible for establishing and maintaining collective trusts under the rules of its direct regulator and standards of the Department of Labor, Internal Revenue Service and other regulatory bodies. This team works closely with internal divisions including the ITA, IFS, Compliance, Legal, etc. The CIT Team currently supports around 470 collective funds with almost $100 + Billion in AUM working with over 135 investment sub-advisors.
cond_0316.responsibilities:
You will handle daily activities associated with collective funds; including but not limited to trade processing, administrative support, and operational setups
You will prepare account opening and maintenance documents for foreign market investments
You will assist CIT Specialists and Trust Officers with governmental filings and regulatory reporting; preparation of materials to be presented to Trust Company board and committees
You will assist in leading access to the CIT website and oversee all processes related to the maintenance of the website
As a record keeper for the funds, you will be working supportively with internal teams regarding the establishment/maintenance of new or changed funds or fund share classes. Additionally, you will be organizing vital reporting for sub-advisors and internal teams
You will communicate with appropriate internal teams or client teams to resolve open issues and questions, collaborate with internal technology support and vendor support when necessary to resolve any production issues or system support queries
cond_0316.requirements:
BA / BS in Business, Accounting, Finance, Economics, Mathematics or equivalent experience
Experience in any of the following fields: Collective Trust Funds, Employee Benefits, Investments, trust and/or insurance administration is ideal but not necessary
Intermediate skills in Microsoft Excel
The self-motivation and aim to supervise multiple client deliverables without sacrificing excellence or quality
Strong written and verbal communication skills as you will primarily support your clients through email and/or phone calls
Strong customer service skills as you will be communicating daily with internal and external clients
An aim to broaden one's knowledge of the financial services industry by learning new concepts and systems and taking the initiative to apply it to daily work assignments
Collaboration with internal and external partners. As the needs of our clients change, we need to be flexible to change with them
Positivity and congenial approach in assisting both colleagues and clients and the ability to work in team environment
Curiosity, critical thinking and attention to detail: Whether it's to identify a solution to a problem or possibly help implement a more efficient process or procedure, your skills have a place in our business

cond_0370.intro:
The Investment Manager Services Division (IMS) at [Company name masked] is growing rapidly and is seeking new members on our Collective Investment Trusts (CIT) team. As an operations analyst, you will coordinate the day-to-day administrative and regulatory functions for our growing list of collective trusts/funds.
[Company name masked]'s CIT Team is responsible for establishing and maintaining collective trusts under the rules of its direct regulator and standards of the Department of Labor, Internal Revenue Service and other regulatory bodies. This team works closely with internal divisions including the ITA, IFS, Compliance, Legal, etc. The CIT Team currently supports around 470 collective funds with almost $100 + Billion in AUM working with over 135 investment sub-advisors.
cond_0370.responsibilities:
You will handle daily activities associated with collective funds; including but not limited to trade processing, administrative support, and operational setups

You will assist in leading access to the CIT website and oversee all processes related to the maintenance of the website
As a record keeper for the funds, you will be working supportively with internal teams regarding the establishment/maintenance of new or changed funds or fund share classes. Additionally, you will be organizing vital reporting for sub-advisors and internal teams

BA / BS in Business, Accounting, Finance, Economics, Mathematics or equivalent experience
Experience in any of the following fields: Collective Trust Funds, Employee Benefits, Investments, trust and/or insurance administration is ideal but not necessary
Intermediate skills in Microsoft Excel
The self-motivation and aim to supervise multiple client deliverables without sacrificing excellence or quality
Strong written and verbal communication skills as you will primarily support your clients through email and/or phone calls
Strong customer service skills as you will be communicating daily with internal and external clients
An aim to broaden one's knowledge of the financial services industry by learning new concepts and systems and taking the initiative to apply it to daily work assignments
Collaboration with internal and external partners. As the needs of our clients change, we need to be flexible to change with them
Positivity and congenial approach in assisting both colleagues and clients and the ability to work in team environment

As an operations analyst, you will work alongside colleagues to support the day-to-day administrative and regulatory functions for our growing list of collective trusts/funds.
[Company name masked]'s CIT Team is responsible for establishing and maintaining collective trusts under the rules of its direct regulator and standards of the Department of Labor, Internal Revenue Service and other regulatory bodies. This team works closely with internal divisions including the ITA, IFS, Compliance, Legal, etc. The CIT Team currently supports around 470 collective funds with almost $100 + Billion in AUM working with over 135 investment sub-advisors.
cond_0414.responsibilities:
You will coordinate daily activities associated with collective funds; including but not limited to trade processing, administrative support, and operational setups
You will help prepare account opening and maintenance documents for foreign market investments
You will support CIT Specialists and Trust Officers with governmental filings and regulatory reporting; preparation of materials to be presented to Trust Company board and committees
You will help facilitate access to the CIT website and work with the team to maintain all processes related to the website
As a record keeper for the funds, you will work alongside internal teams on the establishment and maintenance of new or changed funds or fund share classes. Additionally, you will help organize vital reporting for sub-advisors and internal teams
You will coordinate with appropriate internal teams or client teams to resolve open issues and questions, and work together with internal technology support and vendor support when needed to address production issues or system support queries
cond_0414.requirements:
BA / BS in Business, Accounting, Finance, Economics, Mathematics or equivalent experience
Experience in any of the following fields: Collective Trust Funds, Employee Benefits, Investments, trust and/or insurance administration is ideal but not necessary
Intermediate skills in Microsoft Excel
The self-motivation and aim to supervise multiple client deliverables without sacrificing excellence or quality
Strong written and verbal communication skills as you will primarily support your clients through email and/or phone calls
Strong customer service skills as you will be communicating daily with internal and external clients
An aim to broaden one's knowledge of the financial services industry by learning new concepts and systems and taking the initiative to apply it to daily work assignments
Collaboration with internal and external partners. As the needs of our clients change, we need to be flexible to change with them
Positivity and congenial approach in assisting both colleagues and clients and the ability to work in team environment
Curiosity, critical thinking and attention to detail: Whether it's to identify a solution to a problem or possibly help implement a more efficient process or procedure, your skills have a place in our business
cond_0414.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0414.values: We value ambition, achievement, and consistent follow-through. We believe strong outcomes come from maintaining high expectations for the work we do.

The Investment Manager Services Division (IMS) at [Company name masked] is growing and is looking to add members to our Collective Investment Trusts (CIT) team. As an operations analyst, you will handle day-to-day administrative and regulatory functions for our collective trusts/funds.
[Company name masked]'s CIT Team is responsible for establishing and maintaining collective trusts under the rules of its direct regulator and standards of the Department of Labor, Internal Revenue Service and other regulatory bodies. This team coordinates with internal divisions including the ITA, IFS, Compliance, Legal, etc. The CIT Team currently supports around 470 collective funds with almost $100 + Billion in AUM working with over 135 investment sub-advisors.
cond_0448.responsibilities:
You will handle activities associated with collective funds; including but not limited to trade processing, administrative support, and operational setups
You will prepare account opening and maintenance documents for foreign market investments
You will support CIT Specialists and Trust Officers with governmental filings and regulatory reporting; preparation of materials to be submitted to the Trust Company board and committees
You will assist in managing access to the CIT website and oversee all processes related to the maintenance of the website
As a record keeper for the funds, you will work with internal teams on the establishment and maintenance of new or changed funds or fund share classes. You will also organize reporting for sub-advisors and internal teams
You will communicate with relevant internal or client teams to resolve open issues and questions, and coordinate with internal technology support and vendor support as needed to resolve production issues or system support queries
cond_0448.requirements:
BA / BS in Business, Accounting, Finance, Economics, Mathematics or equivalent experience
Experience in any of the following fields: Collective Trust Funds, Employee Benefits, Investments, trust and/or insurance administration is ideal but not necessary
Intermediate skills in Microsoft Excel
Ability to manage multiple client deliverables without sacrificing quality
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting, as you will primarily support clients through email and/or phone calls
Strong customer service skills as you will be communicating with internal and external clients
Willingness to broaden knowledge of the financial services industry by learning new concepts and systems and applying them to work assignments
Ability to coordinate with internal and external partners and adapt as client needs change
A cooperative and professional approach when assisting colleagues and clients, and the ability to work in a team environment
Curiosity, critical thinking and attention to detail: whether it's identifying a solution to a problem or helping implement a more efficient process or procedure, your skills have a place in our business

cond_0490.intro:
The Investment Manager Services Division (IMS) at [Company name masked] is growing rapidly and is seeking new members on our Collective Investment Trusts (CIT) team. As an operations analyst, you will coordinate the day-to-day administrative and regulatory functions for our growing list of collective trusts/funds.
[Company name masked]'s CIT Team is responsible for establishing and maintaining collective trusts under the rules of its direct regulator and standards of the Department of Labor, Internal Revenue Service and other regulatory bodies. This team works closely with internal divisions including the ITA, IFS, Compliance, Legal, etc. The CIT Team currently supports around 470 collective funds with almost $100 + Billion in AUM working with over 135 investment sub-advisors. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the regulatory and operational logic that underpins collective fund administration.
cond_0490.responsibilities:
What you will do:
You will handle daily activities associated with collective funds; including but not limited to trade processing, administrative support, and operational setups
You will prepare account opening and maintenance documents for foreign market investments
You will assist CIT Specialists and Trust Officers with governmental filings and regulatory reporting; preparation of materials to be presented to Trust Company board and committees
You will assist in leading access to the CIT website and oversee all processes related to the maintenance of the website
As a record keeper for the funds, you will be working supportively with internal teams regarding the establishment/maintenance of new or changed funds or fund share classes. Additionally, you will be organizing vital reporting for sub-advisors and internal teams
You will communicate with appropriate internal teams or client teams to resolve open issues and questions, collaborate with internal technology support and vendor support when necessary to resolve any production issues or system support queries
cond_0490.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BA / BS in Business, Accounting, Finance, Economics, Mathematics or equivalent experience
Intermediate skills in Microsoft Excel
Strong written and verbal communication skills as you will primarily support your clients through email and/or phone calls
Strong customer service skills as you will be communicating daily with internal and external clients
Positivity and congenial approach in assisting both colleagues and clients and the ability to work in team environment
Preferred Requirements
Experience in any of the following fields: Collective Trust Funds, Employee Benefits, Investments, trust and/or insurance administration is ideal but not necessary
The self-motivation and aim to supervise multiple client deliverables without sacrificing excellence or quality
An aim to broaden one's knowledge of the financial services industry by learning new concepts and systems and taking the initiative to apply it to daily work assignments
Collaboration with internal and external partners. As the needs of our clients change, we need to be flexible to change with them
Curiosity, critical thinking and attention to detail: Whether it's to identify a solution to a problem or possibly help implement a more efficient process or procedure, your skills have a place in our business
